messages.subject: Distance 6.0 R2 in Windows 7
parts:
Dear List,



I understand that the most recent release of Distance was not designed to be
compatible with Windows 7, but does anyone have any experience overcoming
display issues running it on this operating system? I am experiencing
problems with scroll bars not appearing, and the editing of raw data.
Currently, I am running it on compatibility mode for XP (SP2), which worked
better than other modes.



I'd also love to know if there are plans to support Windows 7 in the next
release.



Thanks in advance and thanks to the St. Andrews team for the great program,



Greg Levandoski

International Program

Chihuahuan Desert Project Manager

Rocky Mountain Bird Observatory

230 Cherry St. Suite 150

Fort Collins, CO 80521
